free_tier_limits.correction: Free access is subject to a rate limit; NESO may block applications making large numbers of calls. No numerical threshold is stated in the official terms.

description.correction: The API is provided by National Energy System Operator (NESO), not the former National Grid ESO name. It supplies current estimated and forecast carbon-intensity data for Great Britain, including regional and generation-mix data. Forecasts are updated every 30 minutes. Access is free and unauthenticated but rate-limited.

notes: The API and example endpoint were operational on 2026-08-11. The principal error is the claim of unlimited, unrestricted access: official terms explicitly impose a rate limit. The provider name is also outdated, and the submitted docs URL is the project website rather than the dedicated API reference.
